units.source_text: 不知不觉间，小小的群山仿佛锁在雾霭中，渐渐失去了它的轮廓。

en.t: Before one knew it, the small range of hills seemed locked in the mist, gradually losing its outlines.

units.source_text: 就天空的模样来说，这种景象同春雾的景象不同。

en.t: Judging by the look of the sky, this scene was different from the sight of spring haze.

units.source_text: 也许可以说，它更具有京都的特色。

en.t: Perhaps one could say that it had even more of Kyoto's character.
